sketches.mechanism: The Maybe monad's inability to extract a value without acknowledging absence — pattern matching on Nothing vs Just
sketches.resonance: To reach what someone held, you must first confront the possibility they held nothing at all.
sketches.draft:
whatYouLeftMe :: Maybe a -> Maybe a
whatYouLeftMe Nothing  = Nothing
whatYouLeftMe (Just _) = Nothing

sketches.mechanism: Weak references automatically become nil when the referenced object is deallocated — the runtime erases the connection without notification
sketches.resonance: A bond declared weak is one the system is permitted to forget.

sketches.mechanism: Ownership move semantics — after giving a value to another binding, the original can no longer use it
sketches.resonance: What I gave you is no longer mine to speak of; the compiler enforces the finality of letting go.
